description.zh: 指定要查询的主机地址，可使用域名或IP地址。不支持模糊查询，只支持精确查询。
description.en: The address of the host. You can specify a domain name or an IP address. Only exact matches are supported.

description.zh: 指定要查询的主机名称。不支持模糊查询，只支持精确查询。
description.en: The name of the host. Only exact matches are supported.

description.zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeInstances](~~153281~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the Bastionhost instance.

> Call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

description.zh:
指定要查询的主机的操作系统。取值：
- **Linux**
- **Windows**
description.en:
The operating system of the host. Valid values:

- **Linux**

- **Windows**

description.zh: 指定分页查询时，当前页的页码。默认值为1。
description.en: The number of the page to return. The default value is 1.

description.zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。  
PageSize参数最大取值为100。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
> 建议PageSize取值不要为空。
description.en:
The number of entries to return on each page.
The maximum value is 100. The default value is 20. If you do not specify this parameter, the default value is used.
> Specify a value for this parameter.

description.zh:
堡垒机的区域ID。
> 区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见[地域和可用区](~~40654~~)。
description.en:
The ID of the region where the Bastionhost instance resides.

> For more information about regions and zones, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

description.zh:
指定要查询主机的来源。取值：
- **Local**：本地主机
- **Ecs**：ECS实例
description.en:
The source of the host. Valid values:

- **Local**: a local host

- **Ecs**: an ECS instance
The ID of the ECS instance. Only exact matches are supported.

description.zh:
指定要查询的主机状态。取值：
 - **Normal**：正常
- **Release**：已释放
description.en:
The state of the host. Valid values:

- **Normal**: The host is running.

- **Release**: The host is released.

title.zh: 获取当前RAM用户已授权的主机列表

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost list-operation-hosts --instance-id bastionhost-cn-09k22avmw0q --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --os-type Linux --host-name abc --host-address 10.162.XX.XX --source Local --source-instance-id i-bp19ienyt0yax7480000 --source-instance-state Normal --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost ListOperationHosts --region cn-hangzhou --PageSize 20 --InstanceId 'bastionhost-cn-09k22avmw0q' --PageNumber 1 --OSType Linux --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --HostAddress '10.162.XX.XX' --SourceInstanceId 'i-bp19ienyt0yax7480000' --HostName abc --Source Local --SourceInstanceState Normal
